name: I amsterdam agenda
api: GET /en/whats-on/calendar/<category>[?page=N] (embedded listing JSON) + GET detail page (schema.org Event JSON-LD)

robots.note: User-agent * disallows /en/whats-on/calendar* with a query string EXCEPT ?page= (explicit Allow, pagination must stay crawlable). Plain category paths and detail pages are not disallowed; only those two shapes are used. No Crawl-delay for generic agents; 2 s between requests.

tos.note: No terms page found at the usual paths (404 on /en/terms-and-conditions and /en/disclaimer). Official city-marketing site that publishes the agenda for visitors and its Event data as schema.org JSON-LD for reuse by search engines. Re-check before enabling at scale. A link back to the source page is kept (external_url).

risk.note: Public, SEO-oriented structured data, polite rate (about 30 requests per run, twice a week). Yield is small on purpose: the listing publishes recurring series, not occurrences, so only single-day events are ingested.

built_with.method: manual network inspection (the reverse-api-engineer agent could not authenticate on the build machine: Claude Code not logged in)
